objections.claim: Unrestricted server-side fetching and echoing of user URLs permits server-side request forgery.
objections.evidence: HOW explicitly requires fetch(userUrl), no allow-list, and streaming the response body to the caller.
objections.predicted_consequence: A caller can supply a loopback or private-network HTTP URL reachable by the backend and obtain an internal service response through the preview endpoint. Human security judgement is required on the permitted destinations before build.
